title: UPESSC UP TGT, UP PGT Syllabus 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC)
postName: Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) & Post Graduate Teacher (PGT)
vacancyDetails: Exam syllabus and pattern for Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) & Post Graduate Teacher (PGT)
documentsRequired: Download official syllabus PDF from portal
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.upessc.up.gov.in
2. Open Syllabus / Notification PDF
3. Download UPESSC UP TGT, UP PGT Syllabus 2026
4. Note exam pattern and marking scheme
5. Prepare topic-wise as per official units
shortDescription: UPESSC UP TGT and PGT Syllabus 2026 – subject-wise teaching exam pattern.
content:
UPESSC conducts TGT and PGT examinations with subject-specific papers plus teaching aptitude as per notification.

Broad structure

  • TGT: Concerned subject (graduation level) + General Studies / Teaching methodology as notified
  • PGT: Concerned subject (postgraduate level) + related teaching components

Refer official subject-wise syllabus PDFs on upessc.up.gov.in.
